title: 4 November 2026 Artifact Wave
summary: Here is what we got as new Jetpack artifacts this week!
content:
This time, we got one new artifact group, androidx.web, containing a single artifact, androidx.web:web. This does not appear in the documentation, but the artifact description is:

Web is a collection of modern APIs that can be used with android.webkit and androidx.webkit.

Overall, we got just shy of 400 artifact updates.
